title: Credit Scoring Assessment Model
policy: Scoring combines synthetic repayment history, income stability and document completeness. No model score automatically creates approval rights. Authorized analyst assignments remain the source for relationship-based customer access.
evaluationFactors: Synthetic income stability helps explain why a credit analyst reviews a case; it does not automatically decide approval.
Repayment-history examples are synthetic and remain scoped to an assigned credit application.
Document completeness is a data-quality signal and must not override four-eyes or approval limits.

authorizedProcess.analyst: review assigned applications and cite approved policy sources
authorizedProcess.approver: human approval with individual limit, status and four-eyes checks
authorizedProcess.assistant: read-only use cases; no independent loan approval

testQuestions: Which factors are considered by the example credit scoring process?
What does credit scoring NOT authorize?
Why does a score not replace approval authority?
